name: Tupolev Tu-154B-2
summary: The trijet that carried most of the Soviet Union's passengers: three rear engines, a T-tail and main gear that folds into pods behind the wing.

asset.author: Roman Skoryh (visual model), Yurik V. Nikiforoff and the Project Tupolev team

verify.note: With the gear lowered from the model's own animations, the FlightGear model measures 11.84 m tall against the published 11.4 m: its gear struts are modeled unloaded.
